people.name: Arnon
people.line: A river and valley, serving as a boundary for Israel.

people.name: Aroer
people.line: A city on the edge of the Arnon Valley.

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Israel lived in Heshbon and its towns, and in Aroer and its towns, and in all the cities that are along the side of the Arnon for three hundred years! Why didn’t you recover them within that time?
translations.bsb: For three hundred years Israel has lived in Heshbon, Aroer, and their villages, as well as all the cities along the banks of the Arnon. Why did you not take them back during that time?
translations.kjv: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time?
translations.asv: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and its towns, and in Aroer and its towns, and in all the cities that are along by the side of the Arnon, three hundred years; wherefore did ye not recover them within that time?
